scope: Theorem 6.1 of the manuscript “Approximation Paving over Arbitrary Maximal Abelian Subalgebras” (preprints/Approximation-Paving-over-Arbitrary-Maximal-Abelian-Subalgebras-September-25-2026/Approximation-Paving-over-Arbitrary-Maximal-Abelian-Subalgebras-September-25-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 300 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 2207c8250f6c6416), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 30. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every γ > 0 there is an integer Rst(γ) with the following property. For every self-adjoint x ∈ M with ∥x∥ ≤ 1, there are partitions Pj of 1 in A, each with Rst(γ) members, and self-adjoint wj ∈ M such that ∥wj∥ ≤ 2, ∥wj∥φ −→ 0, CPj (x − wj) − EA(x) ≤ γ. (6.1) The integer Rst(γ) is independent of M, A, φ, and x.
